sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
2. The Petitioner is an accused in T.R. Case No.39 of 2021 pending on the file of learned Addl.

District & Sessions Judge-cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Rayagada arising out of Gunupur P . S . C a s e N o . 6 3 o f 2 0 2 1 f o r c o m m i s s i o n o f o f f e n c e a l l e g e d u n d e r S e c t i o n s 363/366/376(2)(n)/376(3) IPC and Section 4(2)/6 of the POCSO Act.
3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Addl.
District & Sessions Judge- cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Rayagada by order dated 27.09.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 7.6.2021.
5.
It is further submitted that in the meanwhile there has been substantial progress in trial and the Informant who is examined as P.W.4 has not supported the prosecution.
Copy of the deposition of the victim is taken on record.
6. It is apt to note that the Petitioner was released on interim bail by order dated 12.01.2023 and the Petitioner has surrendered after due date.
7. Hence, it is submitted that because of the conduct of the Petitioner, he may be released on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail since trial is at the fag end.

9. Considering the nature of allegation and the conduct of the Petitioner as noted and the Petitioner has not misused the trust reposed in him, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
10. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall appear before the learned Court in seisin on each date of trial and shall not leave the jurisdiction without its express permission.
11. The BLAPL thus stands disposed of.
12. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
